title: Fight Horror with Gun
description: Fight Horror with Gun is not just about surviving the night—it is about facing what should not exist, and deciding whether your weapons are enough to keep your sanity intact.
body:
![thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63dcdbd51a4c20ae33630525e27793da2be903fa.png)
Fight Horror with Gun is a dark and intense Minecraft modpack that throws players into a world filled with fear, paranoia, and relentless supernatural threats—where survival depends not only on courage, but also on firepower. This modpack blends psychological horror with modern weaponry, creating a unique experience where you are constantly hunted, watched, and tested by unknown entities lurking in the shadows.

Unlike traditional horror modpacks that focus only on atmosphere, Fight Horror with Gun gives players the ability to fight back. With the inclusion of realistic firearms and combat systems from Timeless and Classic Zero (TaCZ), you are no longer helpless—but that does not mean you are safe. Every sound, every movement, and every moment of silence could mean something is already watching you.

The world is filled with disturbing creatures, anomalies, and entities that behave unpredictably. Some stalk you from the fog, some mimic reality, and others exist purely to break your sense of safety. Exploration becomes a psychological challenge, as caves, forests, and even your own base can become sources of terror.

This modpack is designed to create constant tension. You are never truly alone, and the line between imagination and reality begins to blur as paranoia sets in. Even with weapons in your hands, survival is not guaranteed.

Features:
1. A large collection of horror-themed entities and creatures
2. Psychological horror elements that create paranoia and tension
3. Realistic gun system with modern weapons (TaCZ)
4. Unpredictable encounters and dynamic threats
5. A balance between combat and fear-driven gameplay
6. Exploration that feels dangerous at all times

Included Mods (and more):
1. [TaCZ] Timeless and Classic Zero
2. Batter Cave Dweller
3. CANTBREATHE
4. Doctor Nowhere mod
5. Doctor Who: Weeping Angels
6. Error 404 Not Found (Horror Entity)
7. Flowers Mimic
8. From the Caves
9. From the Fog
10. Grim & Leak
11. Paranoia
12. DCP: Overtime
13. Sons of Sins
14. The Anomaly
15. The Anomaly Rephased
16. The Boiled One: Reimagined
17. The Doppelganger 2
18. The Goatman V4 Reborned
19. The Knocker
20. The Man From The Fog
21. The Midnight Lurker
22. The Obsessed
23. The One Who Watches
24. The Pale Hound
25. The Ravenous

Fight Horror with Gun is not just about surviving the night—it is about facing what should not exist, and deciding whether your weapons are enough to keep your sanity intact.
